text: Experiment 83 turned the grid clockwise twice. Here one turn goes each way, or both anticlockwise, at every pair of widths from 2 to 96: 53,743 new scrambles.
After the two turns a repeating secret word on the table must give the copper's letters where the known letters landed; two known letters in one slot of the word must agree.
No word shorter than 22 letters fits, on the copper or the scrambled coppers, and from 22 up K4 sits inside their range, counted as settings or as distinct check sets.
